featured_reviews.review_text:
I remember when this restaurant first opened; the food was truly authentic, packed with traditional flavors, and every dish felt like a careful, home-cooked labor of love. It was a local gem, and I recommended it to everyone. Unfortunately, based on our experience today, something fundamental in the kitchen has changed, and the taste is no longer the same.
​We visited today hoping for that original, rich experience, but were severely let down by both main components of our order.
​First, the bhakri we received was undoubtedly stale. It was tough, brittle, and tasted distinctly like it had been prepared yesterday and merely reheated.
​Second, the mutton gravy was the biggest disappointment in terms of flavor. The texture and profile felt altered, and upon closer inspection, it was clear why: the dish was bulked up with large amounts of capsicum (bell peppers). While capsicum is a great vegetable, it has absolutely no place in a traditional mutton preparation and completely overrides the authentic spices and meat flavor. This seems like a cost-cutting measure to increase the volume of the dish, but it has killed the signature taste that made this place great.
